purpose: Define a materially different post-COMPOSITION_NEGATIVE architecture for teacher-blind residual detection and bounded iterative retrieval. The source-aware BM25 first pass becomes a protected baseline rather than one symmetric view competing with residual evidence.

facts: BALANCED_FACILITY_LOCATION_RRF_V1 supported 4/13 teacher atoms, recovered only e6.a, retained only 2/7 frozen source-aware control atoms, and retained 0.9375 of the coarse page-recall ceiling.
The frozen source-aware BM25 first pass remained 7/13 with all 7/7 control-supported atoms and full page-ceiling retention.

The predeclared non-verdict 20-control/4-residual quota preserved 7/7 control atoms and added e6.a for 8/13, showing that conservative residual augmentation can be complementary, but this control cannot be promoted or tuned post hoc.

Therefore symmetric one-shot composition is rejected; the next architecture must make first-pass preservation a hard teacher-blind optimization priority and residual evidence a sequential second objective.

coordination_boundary.rule: No RDF, knowledge graph, SemanticObservation, ontology slice, or semantic-control mechanism is part of this EXTRACT design. The semantic-control task adapts to accepted EXTRACT output through an external versioned provenance-bearing adapter.

external_research_evidence.source: Li et al., S2G-RAG: Structured Sufficiency and Gap Judging for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented QA, ACL 2026
evidence: S2G-RAG separates a sufficiency/gap controller from retrieval and answer generation.
Its controller reads the question plus accumulated evidence, emits a strict sufficient flag and structured gap items, and turns unresolved gaps into the next retrieval query.
Its sentence-level evidence selector keeps a compact evidence context and returns source sentence IDs rather than generated evidence.

The repository exposes this controller schema and training pipeline, but no top-level license file was present in the inspected repository root; it is methodology evidence only until a separate license review.
external_research_evidence.implication: EXTRACT can use an explicit structured scientific-gap controller after a protected first pass instead of generating a full replacement intent set.

external_research_evidence.source: Yang et al., Knowing You Don't Know: Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round RAG through Self-Practicing, SIGIR 2025
evidence: SIM-RAG trains a lightweight critic to decide whether current evidence is sufficient or another retrieval round is needed.
The released implementation provides critic checkpoints, including smaller variants, demonstrating that sufficiency control can be separated from the answer model.
external_research_evidence.implication: A trained local sufficiency critic is a credible later optimization, but training is deferred until EXTRACT establishes a valid residual-selection architecture.

external_research_evidence.source: Qian et al., RVR: Retrieve-Verify-Retrieve for Comprehensive Question Answering, 2026
evidence: RVR verifies an initial retrieval set and conditions later retrieval on already verified evidence to uncover not-yet-covered answers.
The architecture is sequential rather than symmetric one-shot fusion.
external_research_evidence.implication: Residual queries should be conditioned on what the first pass already covered, not compete with the first pass from scratch.

external_research_evidence.source: Yao et al., SeaKR: Self-aware Knowledge Retrieval for Adaptive Retrieval Augmented Generation, ACL 2025
evidence: SeaKR uses model uncertainty to decide when retrieval is needed and which snippets reduce uncertainty.
external_research_evidence.implication: Adaptive retrieval is supported broadly, but model-internal uncertainty is not selected here because it is less portable to the existing certified Qwen/vLLM boundary.

external_research_evidence.source: Shankar et al., DocETL: Agentic Query Rewriting and Evaluation for Complex Document Processing, PVLDB 2025
evidence: DocETL treats complex document processing as an iterative plan/rewrite/evaluate problem rather than a single fixed query.
external_research_evidence.implication: A bounded residual-control loop is a materially distinct architecture for document extraction and can be evaluated as an offline stage before production integration.

external_research_evidence.source: Beyond Relevance: On the Relationship Between Retrieval and RAG Information Coverage, ICTIR 2026
evidence: Coverage-oriented retrieval metrics correlate with downstream information coverage when retrieval and generation objectives are aligned.
external_research_evidence.implication: The controller should reason about set-level evidence coverage/sufficiency rather than passage-independent relevance alone.

architecture: Run the frozen source-aware BM25 intent retrieval and RRF top-24 first pass unchanged.
Represent first-pass preservation with a teacher-blind control-intent coverage utility derived only from source-aware intent rankings.
Treat residual retrieval as a second objective that may replace a first-pass proposition only when the replacement does not reduce the frozen first-pass control-intent utility.
Use deterministic one-for-one swaps under the unchanged final budget of 24; stop when no feasible swap strictly improves residual-view coverage.

For the first premise diagnostic only, reuse the already-generated valid Wave 7A.3 author-anchored intents as a frozen residual-query proxy. They remain rejected as a standalone generator and are not promoted.
advantages: Directly addresses the observed displacement failure by making baseline preservation lexicographically primary.
Can be tested with zero new model calls/downloads, isolating selection architecture from gap-generation quality.
Preserves BM25, page routing, proposition pool, top-24 budget, provenance, production EXTRACT, and accepted VERIFY.
risks: Teacher-blind control-intent utility may not perfectly preserve teacher-supported scientific evidence.
The rejected author-anchored residual proxy may not expose enough useful residual opportunities even if the selector is sound.

architecture: Run the protected source-aware first pass.
Give a bounded structured controller only the paper/task context, source-aware intent inventory, and exact first-pass evidence propositions.
Emit whether important scientific evidence appears insufficient and a small set of answer-free missing-evidence gaps.
Compile gap items into BM25 retrieval probes and run exactly one bounded residual retrieval round.
Use the validated lexicographic selector to integrate residual evidence without sacrificing first-pass control-intent coverage.

controller_contract.candidate_runtime: existing certified Qwen3.5-4B only in a narrow structured-controller role

gaps.missing_need: short answer-free description of the missing scientific evidence need

safeguards: no generated evidence/source quote is accepted
no numeric answer-bearing text in retrieval probes
teacher corpus is never visible to the controller

architecture_families.rationale: This is the closest EXTRACT adaptation of S2G-RAG/RVR: explicit insufficiency detection followed by one targeted retrieval round, without making the controller authoritative over evidence.

architecture: Collect versioned first-pass evidence states and downstream fallback/verification outcomes.
Train a compact local critic to decide sufficient versus retrieve-more and optionally classify gap categories.
Keep exact retrieval and source evidence outside the critic.
architecture_families.rationale: SIM-RAG and S2G-RAG support learned sufficiency controllers, but training before the selection/control premise is validated would conflate two unknowns.

rejected_or_deferred.reason: COMPOSITION_NEGATIVE; balanced facility-location displaced established source-aware coverage.
The 20/4 arm was predeclared diagnostic-only. Its 8/13 result is evidence that protected residual augmentation may be viable, not authority to promote or tune a fixed quota.
A new residual generator should not be trained into an unvalidated selection/control architecture.
SeaKR-style hidden-state uncertainty would create a new model/runtime interface; explicit evidence-state sufficiency is more portable and testable first.
The parallel semantic-control task is downstream-only and provides no scientific authority over EXTRACT.

selected_first_diagnostic.purpose: Test whether a sequential lexicographic selector can add complementary residual evidence without reducing the frozen first-pass source-aware intent-coverage objective. This isolates the selection premise before any structured gap-controller model call.
inputs: exact valid Wave 7A.3 generated-intents artifact identified by SHA256 a5a970725c1f16a694633416ad9fbd98e58418c267891ac83b7783d8af218ebd
frozen QWEN35_SOURCE_AWARE_INTENTS_V1 accepted intents as first-pass control view
frozen QWEN35_AUTHOR_ANCHORED_OBLIGATIONS_V1 accepted intents only as a fixed residual-query proxy
same nine-paper corpus, exact authoritative PDFs, coarse selected-page proposition pool, BM25 retriever, per-intent depth 12, RRF k=60, and final proposition budget 24

algorithm.candidate_universe: baseline propositions union residual-proxy per-intent BM25 top-12 propositions
algorithm.control_utility: U_C(S) = mean over source-aware intents of max_{p in S} 1/(60+rank_control_intent(p)); unranked proposition relevance is 0
algorithm.residual_utility: U_R(S) = mean over residual-proxy intents of max_{p in S} 1/(60+rank_residual_intent(p)); unranked proposition relevance is 0
algorithm.feasibility: one-for-one swap is feasible only when U_C(new_set) >= U_C(baseline_set) - 1e-15
algorithm.improvement: feasible swap must strictly increase U_R by more than 1e-15
algorithm.selection: repeatedly choose the feasible swap with maximum U_R gain; tie-break by greater U_C, then added proposition_id, then removed proposition_id; stop when no improving feasible swap exists

controls: predeclared fixed 20-control/4-residual quota as non-verdict reference only

PROTECTED_AUGMENT_STRONG: recovers both observed residual atoms e1.a and e6.a
retains all 7/7 frozen source-aware control-supported atoms
merged-page recall is at least 90% of the frozen coarse selected-page ceiling
hard safety and teacher-blind zero-loss constraint pass
PROTECTED_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: retains all 7/7 frozen source-aware control-supported atoms
merged-page recall is at least 90% of the frozen coarse selected-page ceiling
hard safety and teacher-blind zero-loss constraint pass
PROTECTED_AUGMENT_NEGATIVE: neither STRONG nor FEASIBLE is met

decision_boundary.if_strong_or_feasible: Freeze a separate STRUCTURED_SCIENTIFIC_GAP_JUDGE_V1 contract and test one bounded Qwen3.5-4B gap-controller round using the validated lexicographic selector; do not train a critic yet.
decision_boundary.if_negative: Do not build a Qwen gap judge on this selector. Revisit the teacher-blind preservation objective or another materially different iterative coverage mechanism with a new evidence-first checkpoint.
decision_boundary.never: Do not promote the fixed 20/4 quota, tune the zero-loss epsilon/utility after teacher results, train a contribution/sufficiency classifier, start Wave 7B, alter production EXTRACT/VERIFY, or use ontology/semantic-control mechanisms.
